say:2:1621237201:0.text: Those traps... those toxic fruits—that was all you, wasn't it?
say:2:1621237201:0.source_cn: 那些陷阱、毒果都是你们放的吧……？

say:3:1621237202:1.text: Well, well, look who finally put the pieces together.
say:3:1621237202:1.source_cn: 哼哼，看看咱们的大聪明，终于反应过来了？

say:4:1621237203:1.text: You and your stupid contract. "Take the sick ones", huh?
say:4:1621237203:1.source_cn: 你不是非要搞什么契约吗？什么只能带走体弱动物的蠢规矩——

say:5:1621237204:0.text: That's exactly what I did. I "helped" them along and made sure they'd fit the bill. Easy to take if they're half-dead.
say:5:1621237204:0.source_cn: 我当然得“帮”它们虚弱一点，才能顺理成章地带走。

say:7:1621237206:0.text: Ha! You've done your share of shady things, haven't you, flute man? I'll take that as a compliment.
say:7:1621237206:0.source_cn: 哈！你吹笛人做的下三滥事还少吗？我这就当你在夸我。

say:8:1621237207:0.text: If you were going to break the contract, why pretend it meant anything in the first place?
say:8:1621237207:0.source_cn: 既然你们不打算尊重契约，又何必演这出戏？

say:9:1621237208:1.text: Please. If the boss wasn't vouching for you, no one would care about your little paper promises.
say:9:1621237208:1.source_cn: 哼，要不是老板护着你，谁管你什么狗屁契约？

say:10:1621237209:0.text: But what the boss wants... is the big whale!
say:10:1621237209:0.source_cn: 但是老板要的——是大鲸鱼！

say:13:1621237210:0.text: Chief, that's not a whale, it's a river porpoise...
say:13:1621237210:0.source_cn: 头儿，那不是大鲸鱼，是江豚……

say:14:1621237211:0.text: There aren't even river porpoises in the Lyceum...
say:14:1621237211:0.source_cn: 莱希拉姆根本就没有江豚……

say:17:1621237212:0.text: What?! You think we dragged you all the way to the Lyceum just for a few sick squirrels?!
say:17:1621237212:0.source_cn: 什么！？我们千里迢迢把你送来莱希拉姆，难道就为了这几只...

say:18:1621237213:0.text: I don't know what you're talking about. I'm just helping these animals recover, like the contract said. I'm almost out of herbs, so if you want to pay up, now's the time.
say:18:1621237213:0.source_cn: 我不懂你在说什么，我只是按契约救助这些动物，药材快用完...

say:19:1621237214:0.text: Tch... If we don't find that porpoise, none of us is going back in one piece.
say:19:1621237214:0.source_cn: 哼……要是没见到江豚，我们谁都别想活着回去交差。

say:20:1621237215:0.text: I never promised you a porpoise.
say:20:1621237215:0.source_cn: 我从来没承诺过会找到江豚。

say:21:1621237216:0.text: Then maybe a swim will jog your memory. Let's see how long that attitude lasts underwater!
say:21:1621237216:0.source_cn: 好啊，那你就去水里找吧，看看在水下你还能不能嘴硬！

say:22:1621237217:0.text: Boys, toss him into the lake!

say:25:1621237218:0.text: Wait... chief, are you sure? The higher-ups really like this guy. If something happens...
say:25:1621237218:0.source_cn: 这……头儿，可是……老板对哈梅尔先生非常看重，要是出了事……

say:28:1621237219:0.text: I'll take the heat! If he won't talk, let him find the porpoise himself—at the bottom of the lake!
say:28:1621237219:0.source_cn: 我来担责！动手！既然他说不出江豚在哪，就让他下去慢慢找...

say:29:1621237220:0.text: You're insane! I told you, I haven't seen any porpoise! You can't...
say:29:1621237220:0.source_cn: 你们疯了吗……我说了，我真的没见过江豚！不能这样……
